4659-5267-7924.notes: With the produced mana, the Clues can be sacrificed to their own abilities if desired.

413-618-1916.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Changeling Titan trigger, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1580-2301-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

933-2104-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
933-2104-7757-7758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Conjurer's Closet.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Temporal Manipulation.
Temporal Manipulation's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

661-3685-4659-7753.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Valeria Richards. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3263-6587-7715.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
2388-3263-6587-7715.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

957-7443.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
957-7443.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
957-7443.description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing it to become prepared.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
957-7443.notes: If Emeritus of Abundance is prepared when starting the combo, you can forego attacking with it and skip straight to step 2 the first iteration. This also removes the necessity of Emeritus not have summoning sickness.

1315-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-4428-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-4428-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

222-527-2921-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

6575-6633-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4944-6565.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can be equipped to Cloud by paying {0}.
4944-6565.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cloud.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Equipment's ability, attaching it to Cloud.
Repeat.

791-3693-5426-6093.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5426-6093.description:
Cast Insult by paying {2}{R}, doubling all damage you deal this turn.
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

647-1170-1171.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
647-1170-1171.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

413-1430-5011.description:
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers Blasting Station and its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, choosing not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

760-2353.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
760-2353.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, targeting Swans of Bryn Argoll.
The damage that would be dealt to Swans of Bryn Argoll is prevented, and you draw a card instead.
Repeat from step 2.

770-2430-3415-5218.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by discarding Man-o'-War.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Man-o'-War and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Cast Man-o'-War from exile by discarding Petals of Insight.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, exiling Petals of Insight and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Man-o'-War enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Petals of Insight from exile by discarding Man-o'-War.
Repeat from step 2.

2073-4160-4659.description:
Activate Chimeric Coils, declaring {X} equals 1.
Allow the activation to resolve.
Sacrifice Chimeric Coils to Krark-Clan Ironworks.
Untap Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station, targeting Chimeric Coils.
Repeat.

1636-4770.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{W}.
1636-4770.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm and Whitemane Lion.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm's trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion's trigger, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

250-779-1158.description:
Activate Trespasser il-Vec by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Trespasser il-Vec ability, giving it shadow until end of turn.
Repeat.

3398-4228.notablePrerequisites:
Hellkite Charger does not have summoning sickness.
Bear Umbra attached to Hellkite Charger.
You control lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{R}.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Hellkite Charger.
3398-4228.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as attacker.
Bear Umbra and Hellkite Charger triggers.
Resolve the Bear Umbra's trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger's trigger, choosing to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
